description:
We are pleased to offer our accommodations to travelers with horses needing overnight lodging. We have ten, 10' x 12' covered pens; two, 20' x 20' uncovered pens; one, 
20' x 30' uncovered pen and a round pen. The bunkhouse is fully furnished with a kitchenette and full bathroom, includes bedding and towels, or the ranch house that has a full kitchen, 
1.5 bath with a shower, bedding and towels included. Six dry cabins have air and heat, bedding included, as well as a gas grill, picnic table and apartment size fridge. If you prefer to sleep 
in your own living quarters we have 8 concrete pads with 50 amp service. RV sites are full hookup. WIFI is available throughout the property. Our clubhouse is a great place to relax plus 
it has a coin-operated laundry and bathrooms with showers. Visit our web site or Facebook page for more information and photos of our facilities. Current health papers and negative 
Coggins papers are required. Location notes: East of the town of Aladdin and easy access from Route 24.
